title: Skill-lock registration howto
desc: Execution detail for the source-edit skill-lock. Missed write-vectors to block, glob-pattern registration rules, gate-comment clarity, and the repo-root wk-launcher edit-exempt extension. Core principle is harness-source-edit-requires-skill-lock.
steps: MISSED SOURCE-WRITE VECTORS TO BLOCK (scope ALL to the source-ext regex, EXEMPT .tmp, remedy is the Edit tool or wkappbot file edit). Vectors are in-place stream editors sed -i perl -i awk inplace, binary hex writers dd of= and xxd -r and base64 -d to source, overwrite-by-copy cp mv install ln -f with a source-ext destination, truncate -s and the colon-redirect, inline interpreter writes python -c open-w node -e fs.writeFileSync ruby php, PowerShell .NET writers IO.File WriteAllText Out-File Set-Content Add-Content to source-ext, interactive editors vim vi nano emacs ed that hang a non-interactive shell, and patch source. Proto-first plus test that each does NOT false-block non-source or .tmp before landing.
author: claude
